Class Transaction

java.lang.Object
core.Transaction
public class Transaction extends Object
Represents a library transaction within the library management system. This class records the details of borrowing and returning activities, linking a specific member to a specific book along with the respective dates.

    • Transaction

      public Transaction(String transactionId, String memberId, String bookId, String borrowDate, String returnDate)
      Constructs a new Transaction instance with all the required record details.
      Parameters:
      transactionId - the unique identifier for the transaction
      memberId - the unique identifier of the member involved in the transaction
      bookId - the unique identifier of the book being borrowed or returned
      borrowDate - the date when the book was borrowed
      returnDate - the date when the book was returned (or expected to be returned)
